title: P0.37-runtime: Active Incident Frame + Guided Human Assistance
description: When external ChatGPT consultation is blocked by security verification, IABV must keep a structured active incident so follow-up messages such as 'como te puedo ayudar' and 'abreme la ventana' are resolved against the external failure instead of falling to local chat.
reason: Live runtime showed blocked_by_security_verification in runtime_audit.jsonl, but the runtime loaded by the desktop shortcut did not have ActiveIncidentFrame wiring. The program could explain the old failure but could not focus/open the relevant window or guide the user through the current incident.
next_action: Run IABV from the desktop shortcut, trigger ChatGPT consultation, then type 'abre la ventana donde se te presenta la verificacion de seguridad'. Expected: incident_followup_intent_classified appears in runtime_audit.jsonl, local chat is suppressed, and IABV either focuses the exact Chrome profile window tied to the incident or opens that exact profile. If the opened profile works normally, type 'ya funciona' or 'ya lo hice' so IABV retests instead of repeating stale security-verification guidance.
resume_hint: Implemented in the runtime workspace loaded by the desktop shortcut. P0.37.1 adds profile-specific Chrome window targeting, typo-tolerant show-problem intent, exact-profile fallback opening, and stale-block retest phrases. Code is verified by focused tests; live Windows proof remains pending.

evidence: user asked how to help or open the problem window, but runtime could only repeat local/failure explanation
implemented: Create active incident frame from external failure memory and runtime audit recovery
Classify incident follow-ups semantically: help_offer, show_problem, visibility_dispute, profile_mismatch, launch_bridge, switch_bridge, retry_done
Route incident follow-up before local chat and before stale external-failure explanation
Attempt to focus the target window via hwnd from incident metadata or WorldModel active windows
Prefer Chrome windows whose process command line matches the incident profile before considering generic WorldModel windows
Open the exact assistant profile when no focusable window exists, instead of opening the user's normal Chrome
Treat user reports such as 'ya funciona' and 'no hay verificacion' as a retest request so stale security blocks can be cleared
Recognize common typo 'venta' when the user asks to open the problem window
Clear stale IABV_PREFER_CDP_SESSION when CDP probe is unavailable
Export compact active incident summary to PortableContext
OSES reports blocked external incident followed by local fallback
unresolved: LIVE_PROOF: requires Windows runtime execution with ChatGPT security block
window_focus depends on live hwnd availability from WorldModel
CDP bridge requires user login once in governed bridge profile if ChatGPT asks
If the exact profile opens and ChatGPT works normally, the previous browser_security_verification event was stale and must be cleared only by governed retest
